observations.body: Holiness is addressed through bodily conduct and the Spirit. Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more. Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.
